purpose: Non-admission source candidates for independent European windstorm event-loss and damage-function validation, with strict observational versus modelled and licensing boundaries.

entries.name: HANZE European Windstorm Impact Database v1.0 (1950-2020)
entries.provider: University of Szczecin researchers for European Commission JRC; Zenodo record 15266959
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, country-identified records with NUTS2 and occasional NUTS3 affected-region strings; affected regions are not asset coordinates or insured exposure footprints
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Original XLSX 292136 bytes, 12 ZIP parts, 5294 shared strings; 2 XLSX worksheets. Primary windstorm-impact data: 20 exact published columns and 1358 country-event rows (33 country codes, 1950–2020); separate 815-row source-reference sheet. Original complete-file MD5 0a523543adf76003916186623812ab74 matches Zenodo; original SHA256 c2fe636c9e7a1e601d64f00f5bdef8fdf9aaa854060f4d5edcd02e1405140944.
entries.note: 2026-11-05 COMPLETE ORIGINAL XLSX STRUCTURAL AUDIT (source SHA256 c2fe636c9e7a1e601d64f00f5bdef8fdf9aaa854060f4d5edcd02e1405140944, 8 exact HTTP ranges, MD5 matched original publisher): 1358 country-level event records and 1358 distinct publisher IDs across 33 country codes, 1950–2020; 815 bibliographic reference rows on a separate sheet; original 2020 EUR millions economic-loss field has exactly 720 nonempty cells and 638 BLANK/UNKNOWN cells. The original CDS field (column S) flags exactly 299 country-event losses 'Modelled economic loss from CDS', categorically NOT independent observed C3S/CLIMK loss holdouts. Named Kyrill has 12 country rows and 4 CDS-modelled (AT, IE, LU, PL); never treat them as 12 independent physical storms. The source stores mixed ISO and numeric Excel 1900-serial dates: three preliminary apparent inverted ranges resolved after legitimate serial conversion; one suspect ES row 21072 remains with 2017-02-02 start and 2014-02-02 end. Reproducible bounded stdlib parsing code and offline synthetic tests reside in research_runners/hanze_windstorm_original_workbook_audit_v0.py and tests. These source-row/schema counts do NOT clear upstream rights, observed-vs-derived status of the other rows, completeness, storm parent-ID/annual frequency, geospatial asset mapping, insurer contract semantics or admission. No original XLSX bytes committed. Source metadata advertises CC BY 4.0; third-party conditions and website research-only statement still require separate human review. All review statuses explicitly remain not_admitted/not_reviewed.

entries.name: Norwegian 1985-2020 municipality-level insured wind-damage study
entries.provider: Jaison, Sorteberg, Michel and Breivik; Norwegian Natural Perils Pool; NHESS 2024
entries.spatial_scope: Norway, 356 municipalities in the authors' harmonized study; not individual geocoded insured properties
entries.temporal_scope: 1985-2020 daily insurance counts and amounts, paper published 2024-04-23
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Published study compares daily municipality claims and losses with NORA3 winds and four damage functions; article, figures and supplements publicly accessible, but original daily insurance claim dataset is explicitly proprietary and unavailable for download
entries.note: Article data-availability paragraph explicitly says the daily insurance data cannot be shared; the paper CC BY 4.0 is NOT a licence to reproduce proprietary Norwegian claims. NORA3 winds are publicly available and Finance Norway NASK provides some public statistics, but neither automatically recreates the 356-municipality daily 36-year time series. Strong independent published validation methodology and zero-inflation finding only until a separately authorized source-level aggregate or data-use agreement is verified.
